description: t.c spawns a counter server and casts 5 to it; the driver cancels the server's task at 50, so its loop ends and its mailbox is closed. t.c's cast, try_cast and call at 100 each find the server gone and are refused with ASX_E_DISCONNECTED (a stopping server, vocabulary 5): no cast waits for room that will never come, and the call does not wait for a reply.
